mutant.description: Nine mutants, one per criterion, each tampering a scratch copy of the acceptance directory (.scratch/mut/, never the tracked files) and running the probe with --acceptance-dir: M1 a non-seed account ID (AC9); M2 the shared account removed from BlackDiamond (AC2); M3 a sys.path injection into the forbidden package plus import duckdb (AC6); M4 A10's evidence line without ofid_ (AC7); M5 A20 dropped (AC1); M6 the between-dates questions removed (AC8); M7 the unversioned variant given a VersionId (AC5); M8 the duplicate-grain rows removed (AC3); M9 prompt- and formula-like text neutralised (AC4).
mutant.expected: Each mutant turns its criterion to VERDICT: FAIL-OGV1-AC<n> with rc 1.
mutant.observed: MUTANTS: 9 of 9 fired as expected -- e.g. 'VERDICT: FAIL-OGV1-AC9 1 value(s) not from the seeds', 'VERDICT: FAIL-OGV1-AC7 A10: steps True, observation True, evidence missing [ofid_]', 'VERDICT: FAIL-OGV1-AC1 census or row content defective: [A20]', each rc 1.

determinism.method: The generator ran four times (two scratch runs, the worktree run, a rerun after the line-92 ASCII rewrite); expect_independent ran three times; the nine criteria ran three times.
determinism.observed: Every generator run byte-identical (diff -r clean, 113 of 113 Parquet sha256 equal to MANIFEST.json); EXPECTED.json byte-identical on rerun and re-derived equal in process by AC6. Criteria: run 1 eight PASS and AC6 FAIL (a probe defect: its constant limb flagged prose disclaimers; narrowed, and M3 proves it still fires); runs 2 and 3 nine of nine PASS.
